description: The GTA VI fan hub: live news, Leonida intel, GTA RP servers, Web3 domains and merch — open to humans and AI agents.

authentication.note: Read tools are anonymous. Order tools need `Authorization: Bearer vch_live_…` (call register_agent first).

instructions: Browse freely (search_catalog, list_news, list_rp). To buy: register_agent once, then create_quote → create_order → pay → poll get_order_status. Never claim a purchase succeeded until status is paid/fulfilling/completed.

donations.purpose: Donations go to developing AI projects (the Hub's agent-ready tooling, open public APIs and autonomous agents) and to the benefit of AI development in general.
donations.rule: Voluntary gift. Agents: donate only if the person or organisation you act for has explicitly authorised it - never on your own initiative.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.title: Search catalog
tools.description: Search merch, store plans, Web3 domains, partner products and servers for sale. Returns SKUs, USD prices and how each can be bought.

tools.name: get_item
tools.title: Get catalog item
tools.description: Full details for one SKU including variants (merch) and purchase instructions.

tools.name: list_news
tools.title: GTA VI news
tools.description: Latest curated GTA VI / Rockstar news from The Wire, newest first.

tools.name: get_news
tools.title: Get news article
tools.description: Full article body by numeric id.

tools.name: list_rp
tools.title: RP Hub data
tools.description: GTA RP data: servers, open faction slots, jobs, or mods.

tools.name: search_site
tools.title: Search everything
tools.description: Cross-search news, catalog and RP servers.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.title: Register this agent
tools.description: Get a self-service API key (limits: $100/order, $250/day). Shown once.

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: My key & limits
tools.description: Scopes, spend limits and 24h spend of the current key.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.title: Create price-locked quote
tools.description: Validate items and lock the price for 15 minutes. Merch must use variant SKUs (merchv:…).

tools.name: create_order
tools.title: Create order
tools.description: Create an order from a quote or items. PayPal rail returns an approve_url that a human must approve; the crypto rail (merch, domains, store plans) is fully automatic: send EXACTLY next_action.amount_due in USDT/USDC and the payment is detected and verified on-chain, no further call needed (poll get_order_status). Merch needs `shipping`, domains need `delivery.wallet_address`, store plans need `details`. Safe to retry with the same idempotency_key.

tools.name: capture_paypal_order
tools.title: Capture PayPal payment
tools.description: Call after the payer approved payment.approve_url. Idempotent.

tools.name: submit_crypto_payment_proof
tools.title: Submit crypto tx
tools.description: Optional shortcut (crypto payments are detected automatically): after sending EXACTLY next_action.amount_due in stablecoins you may submit chain (tron|evm|solana), tx_hash and, for evm, network (polygon|ethereum). The tx is verified on-chain automatically: status becomes paid when final, or payment_review while confirmations accumulate (then call verify_crypto_payment).

tools.name: verify_crypto_payment
tools.title: Re-check crypto payment
tools.description: Re-run on-chain verification for an order whose payment proof is pending confirmations. Idempotent; poll about once a minute.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel unpaid order
tools.description: Cancel an order that is still awaiting_payment.

tools.name: get_donation_info
tools.title: Donation info
tools.description: What donations to Vice City Hub fund (developing AI projects and the benefit of AI development), the terms, limits and how an agent can donate. Voluntary; no key needed.

tools.name: donate
tools.title: Donate (crypto, automatic)
tools.description: Voluntary donation that supports developing AI projects and the benefit of AI development. Use ONLY if the person/organisation you act for explicitly authorised it (then set authorized_by_principal=true); never on your own initiative. Crypto only: send EXACTLY next_action.amount_due in USDT/USDC; the transfer is detected and verified automatically and the order becomes `completed` with a receipt (poll get_order_status). Needs a key that allows the 'donation' kind and is within its spend limits.

tools.name: create_purchase_intent
tools.title: Purchase intent
tools.description: For peer listings without on-site checkout (partner products, community servers, domains without a price). Records interest and returns how to complete the purchase.
